verdict.rationale: Salv documents policy-bounded automation. Clearance rules auto-close only the alerts that meet conditions you set, and each closure stays on an audit trail. AI-Powered Insights is explicitly informational and never closes an alert or makes the decision, so remaining alerts are left for human review. Cases can be worked with an assignee and status. Missing for 10: explicit routing or escalation of ambiguous or high-risk findings to a named human reviewer, documented risk-threshold-based escalation policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human

citations.quote: Clearance rules close alerts that meet conditions you set, from the library or your own, and every auto-closed alert stays on the record as an audit trail.
it's informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision.
Open a case, attach the related alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status
